title: Rollback Briefing Mini-Playbook Panel (compact prototype)
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Design a compact, low-friction ‘mini-playbook’ panel that surfaces an immediate rollback briefing inside the Rollouts timeline and variant inspector. Purpose: enable engineers and incident responders to make faster revert decisions without leaving the console. The panel should summarize key signals, present an actionable risk score, show estimated user/cost impact of a rollback, and provide a quick rollback button with a confirm flow and optional rollback simulation. Must work in constrained vertical space (sidebar / popover) and remain legible at small widths. Consider data freshness, empty states, and graceful degradation when telemetry is delayed.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Aisha: Kickoff with PM and Eng to align on scope. Agreed compact panel lives in the right-hand timeline rail and as a hover-over for variant rows.

2025-02-21 - Liam: Drafted three wireframe directions: (A) a single-column summary card, (B) stacked mini-cards for signals + actions, (C) tabbed compact view. Chose (B) for scanability during incident response.
2025-02-24 - PM (Jordan): Requested an explicit 'estimated user impact' metric and a simulated token-cost delta for rollback to help commercial conversations.
2025-02-25 - Eng (Maya): Raised data availability constraints for historical cohorts; suggested a 30s freshness indicator and fallback to 'last known' with tooltip.
2025-02-28 - Design: High-fidelity prototype uploaded for usability tests. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/Rollback-Mini-Playbook-Prototype

2025-03-02 - Usability test summary: 6 designers/engineers. People liked the single-click rollback but asked for a micro-confirm that shows which variant will receive traffic post-revert. Also requested keyboard shortcut and ARIA live region for screen readers.

2025-03-04 - Liam: Updated hi-fi to include 'Simulate rollback' toggle that runs a 60s hypothetical impact preview using current signal baselines. Simulation UI will show expected change in error-rate and latency with a small confidence band.
2025-03-05 - PM Review (Jordan): Good to ship as an opt-in beta behind a feature flag for Dedicated customers first. Ask: include instrumentation events for telemetry and cost accounting.
2025-03-06 - Design Review (Aisha): Collated notes for dev handoff and accessibility adjustments; marking ticket Ready for Dev with follow-ups for ENG-51234 on telemetry endpoints.
decisions: Use stacked mini-cards layout (signals, impact, action) to optimize for quick scanning under stress.
Expose a one-click 'Rollback' CTA with a micro-confirm modal that includes: affected variants, expected traffic distribution post-revert, and a link to the full Rollout runbook.
Implement a lightweight 'Simulate rollback' toggle that displays estimated delta for primary signals for 60s; simulation to be labelled as hypothetical with confidence band.
Show 'data freshness' timestamp and fallback copy when telemetry is stale.
next_steps: Finalize token/cost delta UX with Finance/PM and add to design spec (due 2025-03-10).
Handoff to Eng: create API contract for rollback-simulation and brief summary signals (ENG-51234 updated).
Implement accessibility changes: keyboard shortcut, ARIA live region for action results, focus trap in micro-confirm modal.
Ship behind feature flag for Dedicated + selected beta orgs; add telemetry events for action clicks and simulation runs.
accessibility_notes: Ensure panel is navigable via keyboard (tab order: signals -> simulate toggle -> rollback CTA). Use aria-live polite for simulation results and aria-describedby for micro-confirm details. Maintain 4.5:1 contrast for small text; increase hit target for CTA to 44x44px on touch devices.
